rationale: A break of the half-hour opening range on above-normal volume comes from real order flow, and it carries furthest when price already sits on the break's side of the day's VWAP (buyers' average cost under an up break), so the main setting is how many sigmas from VWAP price must be at 10:00 (0, 0.5, 1) before the break is taken. Losing side: Traders who fade the first break of the half-hour opening range and are stopped as heavy volume pushes it on, and traders who buy a break while the whole morning's volume-weighted average sits above price.
